1.en: O you enveloped in your mantle the Prophet s al-muddaththir is actually al-mutadaththir but the tā’ has been assimilated with the dāl that is to say the one who is enwrapped in his clothes when the Revelation Gabriel comes down on him
1.ar:
سُورَة المُدَّثِّر مَكِّيَّة وآياتها سِتّ وخَمْسُونَ

﴿يا أيّها المُدَّثِّر﴾ النَّبِيّ ﷺ وأَصْله المُتَدَثِّر أُدْغِمَتْ التّاء فِي الدّال أيْ المُتَلَفِّف بِثِيابِهِ عِنْد نُزُول الوَحْي عَلَيْهِ

2.en: arise and warn threaten the people of Mecca with punishment in the Fire should they refuse to believe;
2.ar: ﴿قُمْ فَأَنْذِرْ﴾ خَوِّفْ أهْل مَكَّة النّار إنْ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا

3.en: and magnify your Lord exalt Him above what is ascribed to Him by the idolaters;

4.en: and purify your clothes from impurity or it means shorten them instead of imitating the way in which the Arabs are wont to let their robes drag behind them out of vanity for perhaps they will be sullied by some impurity;
4.ar: ﴿وثِيابك فَطَهِّرْ﴾ عَنْ النَّجاسَة أوْ قَصِّرْها خِلاف جَرّ العَرَب ثِيابهمْ خُيَلاء فَرُبَّما أصابَتْها نَجاسَة

5.en: and shun all defilement this rijz was explained by the Prophet s to be the graven images; in other words persist in shunning them.
5.ar: ﴿والرُّجْز﴾ فَسَّرَهُ النَّبِيّ ﷺ بِالأَوْثانِ ﴿فاهْجُرْ﴾ أيْ دُمْ عَلى هَجْره

6.en: And do not grant a favour seeking greater gain read tastakthiru as a circumstantial qualifier in other words do not give something in order to demand more in return this stipulation is specific to the Prophet s since he is enjoined to adopt the fairest traits and the noblest of manners;
6.ar: ﴿ولا تَمْنُنْ تَسْتَكْثِر﴾ بِالرَّفْعِ حال أيْ لا تُعْطِ شَيْئًا لِتَطْلُب أكْثَر مِنهُ وهَذا خاصّ بِهِ ﷺ لِأَنَّهُ مَأْمُور بِأَجْمَل الأَخْلاق وأَشْرَف الآداب

7.en: and endure patiently for the sake of your Lord all His commands and prohibitions.

8.en: For when the trumpet is sounded when the trumpet is blown that is the Horn qarn at the second blast
8.ar: ﴿فَإذا نُقِرَ فِي النّاقُور﴾ نُفِخَ فِي الصُّور وهُوَ القَرْن النَّفْخَة الثّانِيَة

9.en: that day that is to say the time of the sounding yawma’idhin is a substitution for the preceding subject and is not declined because it is annexed to something that cannot be declined; the predicate of the subject is the following will be a harsh day idhā is operated by what is indicated by the statement ishtadda’l-amru ‘for when the trumpet is sounded the situation will be terrible’
9.ar: ﴿فَذَلِكَ﴾ أيْ وقْت النَّقْر ﴿يَوْمئِذٍ﴾ بَدَل مِمّا قَبْله المُبْتَدَأ وبُنِيَ لِإضافَتِهِ إلى غَيْر مُتَمَكِّن وخَبَر المُبْتَدَأ ﴿يَوْم عَسِير﴾ والعامِل فِي إذا ما دَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الجُمْلَة اشْتَدَّ الأَمْر

10.en: for the disbelievers not at all easy herein is an indication that it will be easy for believers despite its harshness.
10.ar: ﴿عَلى الكافِرِينَ غَيْر يَسِير﴾ فِيهِ دَلالَة عَلى أنَّهُ يَسِير عَلى المُؤْمِنِينَ فِي عُسْره

11.en: Leave Me to deal with him whom I created wa-man khalaqtu is a supplement to the direct object or it is an object of accompaniment lonely wahīdan is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the man ‘whom’ or to the pronoun referring to it but omitted from khalaqtu sc. khalaqtuhu alone without family or wealth — this was al-Walīd b. al-Mughīra al-Makhzūmī —
11.ar: ﴿ذَرْنِي﴾ اُتْرُكْنِي ﴿ومَن خَلَقْت﴾ عَطْف عَلى المَفْعُول أوْ مَفْعُول مَعَهُ ﴿وحِيدًا﴾ حال مِن مَن أوْ مِن ضَمِيره المَحْذُوف مِن خَلَقْت مُنْفَرِدًا بِلا أهْل ولا مال هُوَ الوَلِيد بْن المُغِيرَة المَخْزُومِيّ
asbab: عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: أن الوليد بن المغيرة جاء إلى النبي ﷺ فقرأ عليه القرآن، فكأنه رق له فبلغ ذلك أبا جهل، فقال له: أي عم إن قومك يريدون أن يجمعوا لك مالاً ليعطوكه، فإنك أتيت محمداً تتعرض لما قبله، قال: قد علمت قريش أني من أكثرها مالاً، قال: فقل فيه قولاً يبلغ قومك أنك منكر له وكاره. قال: وماذ أقول؟ فوالله ما فيكم رجل أعلم بالأشعار مني، ولا أعلم برجزها ولا بقصيدها مني، والله ما يشبه الذي يقوله شيئاً من هذا، والله إن لقوله الذي يقوله حلاوة، وإن عليه لطلاوة، وإنه لمثمر أعلاه، مغدق أسفله، وإنه ليعلو وما يعلى، قال: والله لا يرضى عنك قومك حتى تقول فيه. قال: فدعني حتى أفكر فيه، فقال: هذا سحر يؤثر، يأثره عن غيره، فنزلت: { ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا ﴿١١﴾ }.

12.en: and then assigned him ample means abundant and continuous generated from his crops livestock and commerce
12.ar: ﴿وجَعَلْت لَهُ مالًا مَمْدُودًا﴾ واسِعًا مُتَّصِلًا مِن الزُّرُوع والضُّرُوع والتِّجارَة

13.en: and sons ten or more present by his side present at social gatherings and whose testimonies are listened to
13.ar: ﴿وبَنِينَ﴾ عَشَرَة أوْ أكْثَر ﴿شُهُودًا﴾ يَشْهَدُونَ المَحافِل وتُسْمَع شَهاداتهمْ

14.en: and facilitated extended for him greatly his livelihood duration of life and children.

15.en: Still he is eager that I should give him more.

16.en: Nay! I shall not give him more than that. He is indeed stubborn to Our signs to the Qur’ān.
16.ar: ﴿كَلّا﴾ لا أزِيدهُ عَلى ذَلِكَ ﴿إنّهُ كانَ لِآياتِنا﴾ القُرْآن ﴿عَنِيدًا﴾ مُعانِدًا

17.en: Soon I shall burden him with a trying chastisement; alternatively sa‘ūdan means a mountain of fire which he will be made to ascend and then fall down from forever.
17.ar: ﴿سَأُرْهِقُهُ﴾ أُكَلِّفهُ ﴿صَعُودًا﴾ مَشَقَّة مِن العَذاب أوْ جَبَلًا مِن نار يَصْعَد فِيهِ ثُمَّ يَهْوِي أبَدًا

18.en: Indeed he pondered what to say about the Qur’ān which he heard from the Prophet s and decided this in his mind.
18.ar: ﴿إنّهُ فَكَّرَ﴾ فِيما يَقُول فِي القُرْآن الَّذِي سَمِعَهُ مِن النَّبِيّ ﷺ ﴿وقَدَّرَ﴾ فِي نَفْسه ذَلِكَ

19.en: Perish he may he be cursed and chastised how he decided! perish he whatever the nature of his decision may have been.
19.ar: ﴿فَقُتِلَ﴾ لُعِنَ وعُذِّبَ ﴿كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ﴾ عَلى أيّ حال كانَ تَقْدِيره

20.en: Again perish he how he decided!

21.en: Then he contemplated the faces of his people; or he contemplated with what words he might cast aspersions upon it.
21.ar: ﴿ثُمَّ نَظَرَ﴾ فِي وُجُوه قَوْمه أوْ فِيما يَقْدَح بِهِ فِيهِ

22.en: Then he frowned he contracted his face and glowered anguished by what he wanted to say and scowled increasing the contracting and the glowering in his face.
22.ar: ﴿ثُمَّ عَبَسَ﴾ قَبَضَ وجْهه وكَلَّحَهُ ضِيقًا بِما يَقُول ﴿وبَسَرَ﴾ زادَ فِي القَبْض والكُلُوح

23.en: Then he turned his back to faith in disdain scornful of following the Prophet s
23.ar: ﴿ثُمَّ أدْبَرَ﴾ عَنْ الإيمان ﴿واسْتَكْبَرَ﴾ تَكَبَّرَ عَنْ اتِّباع النَّبِيّ ﷺ

24.en: and said of what he the Prophet had brought ‘This is nothing but handed-down sorcery learnt from sorcerers;
24.ar: ﴿فَقالَ﴾ فِيما جاءَ بِهِ ﴿إنْ﴾ ما ﴿هَذا إلّا سِحْر يُؤْثَر﴾ يُنْقَل عَنْ السَّحَرَة

25.en: this is nothing but the speech of humans’ similar to what they the idolaters had said ‘It is only a human that is teaching him’ Q. 16103.
25.ar: ﴿إنْ﴾ ما ﴿هَذا إلّا قَوْل البَشَر﴾ كَما قالُوا إنّما يُعَلِّمهُ بَشَر

26.en: I shall soon admit him into Saqar! — Hell.

27.en: And how would you know what is Saqar? — this interrogative is intended to emphasise its enormity.

28.en: It neither spares nor leaves behind anything of flesh or nerve but destroys it all after which he is restored to his former state.
28.ar: ﴿لا تُبْقِي ولا تَذَر﴾ شَيْئًا مِن لَحْم ولا عَصَب إلّا أهْلَكَتْهُ ثُمَّ يَعُود كَما كانَ

29.en: It burns away the flesh scorching the surface of skin.

30.en: There are nineteen keepers standing over it angels its keepers; a certain disbeliever who was a mighty stalwart said ‘I will avail you seventeen of them if you avail me just two’. God exalted be He says
30.ar: ﴿عَلَيْها تِسْعَة عَشَر﴾ مَلَكًا خَزَنَتها قالَ بَعْض الكُفّار وكانَ قَوِيًّا شَدِيد البَأْس أنا أكْفِيكُمْ سَبْعَة عَشَر واكْفُونِي أنْتُمْ اثْنَيْنِ قالَ تَعالى:

31.en: And We have appointed only angels as wardens of the Fire in other words and so they cannot be withstood as these disbelievers are wont to imagine; and We have made their number so only as a stumbling-block a cause for error for those who disbelieve when they then say ‘Why are there nineteen of them?’ so that those who were given the Scripture namely the Jews may be certain of the sincerity of the Prophet s in saying that they are nineteen for this concords with what is in their Scripture; and that those who believe from among the People of the Scripture may increase in faith in affirmation of the truth given that what the Prophet s has said concords with what is in their Scripture and that those given the Scripture and the believers those other than these Jews may not be in doubt concerning the number of these angels and that those in whose hearts there is a sickness an uncertainty those in Medina and the disbelievers in Mecca may say ‘What did God mean by this number as a similitude?’ mathalan they referred to it thus as a mathal on account of it being a curious matter; in terms of syntax it mathalan is a circumstantial qualifier. Thus that is just as the one who rejects this number is led astray and the one who affirms the truth of it is guided God leads astray whom He will and guides whom He will. And none knows the hosts of your Lord namely the angels none knows them in terms of their strength and their assistants except Him. And it that is Saqar is nothing but a reminder for humans.
31.ar: ﴿وما جَعَلْنا أصْحاب النّار إلّا مَلائِكَة﴾ أيْ فَلا يُطاقُونَ كَما يَتَوَهَّمُونَ ﴿وما جَعَلْنا عِدَّتهمْ﴾ ذَلِكَ ﴿إلّا فِتْنَة﴾ ضَلالًا ﴿لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ بِأَنْ يَقُولُوا لِمَ كانُوا تِسْعَة عَشَر ﴿لِيَسْتَيْقِن﴾ لِيَسْتَبِينَ ﴿الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الكِتاب﴾ أيْ اليَهُود صِدْق النَّبِيّ ﷺ فِي كَوْنهمْ تِسْعَة عَشَر المُوافِق لِما فِي كِتابهمْ ﴿ويَزْداد الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ مِن أهْل الكِتاب ﴿إيمانًا﴾ تَصْدِيقًا لِمُوافَقَتِهِ ما أتى بِهِ النَّبِيّ ﷺ لِما فِي كِتابهمْ ﴿ولا يَرْتاب الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الكِتاب والمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ مِن غَيْرهمْ فِي عَدَد المَلائِكَة ﴿ولِيَقُولَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبهمْ مَرَض﴾ شَكّ بِالمَدِينَةِ ﴿والكافِرُونَ﴾ بِمَكَّة ﴿ماذا أرادَ اللَّه بِهَذا﴾ العَدَد ﴿مَثَلًا﴾ سَمَّوْهُ لِغَرابَتِهِ بِذَلِكَ وأُعْرِبَ حالًا ﴿كَذَلِكَ﴾ أيْ مِثْل إضْلال مُنْكِر هَذا العَدَد وهَدى مُصَدِّقه ﴿يُضِلّ اللَّه مَن يَشاء ويَهْدِي مَن يَشاء وما يَعْلَم جُنُود رَبّك﴾ أيْ المَلائِكَة فِي قُوَّتهمْ وأَعْوانهمْ ﴿إلّا هُوَ وما هِيَ﴾ أيْ سَقَر

32.en: Nay kallā denoting a commencement of a new sentence to be understood as alā by the moon!

33.en: And by the night when it returns! if read as idhā dabara when it comes back after day a variant reading has idh adbara meaning ‘when it has receded’.
33.ar: ﴿واللَّيْل إذا﴾ بِفَتْحِ الذّال ﴿أدْبَرَ﴾ جاءَ بَعْد النَّهار وفِي قِراءَة إذا أدْبَرَ بِسُكُونِ الذّال بَعْدها هَمْزَة أيْ مَضى

34.en: And by the dawn when it appears!

35.en: Verily it that is Saqar is one of the enormities one of the greatest calamities —

36.en: a warning nadhīran is a circumstantial qualifier referring to ihdā ‘one of’ and it is masculine because it denotes masculine ‘adhāb ‘chastisement’ to all humans;
36.ar: ﴿نَذِيرًا﴾ حال مِن إحْدى وذُكِّرَ لِأَنَّها بِمَعْنى العَذاب

37.en: alike to those of you who wish li-man shā’a minkum is a substitution for li’l-bashar ‘to all humans’ to advance towards good or towards Paradise by means of faith or linger behind in evil or in Hell because of their disbelief.
37.ar: ﴿لِمَن شاءَ مِنكُمْ﴾ بَدَل مِن البَشَر ﴿أنْ يَتَقَدَّم﴾ إلى الخَيْر أوْ الجَنَّة بِالإيمانِ ﴿أوْ يَتَأَخَّر﴾ إلى الشَّرّ أوْ النّار بِالكُفْرِ

38.en: Every soul is held to ransom by what it earns it is ransomed and requited for its deeds with the Fire
38.ar: ﴿كُلّ نَفْس بِما كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَة﴾ مَرْهُونَة مَأْخُوذَة بِعَمَلِها فِي النّار

39.en: except those of the right hand namely the believers who will be saved from it and who will be
39.ar: ﴿إلّا أصْحاب اليَمِين﴾ وهُمْ المُؤْمِنُونَ فَناجُونَ مِنها كائِنُونَ

41.en: about the guilty and their predicament; and they will say to them after all those who believed in the One God muwahhidūn are brought out of the Fire
41.ar: ﴿عَنْ المُجْرِمِينَ﴾ وحالهمْ ويَقُولُونَ لَهُمْ بَعْد إخْراج المُوَحِّدِينَ مِن النّار

42.en: ‘What has landed you in what has made you enter Saqar?’

43.en: They will say ‘We were not of those who prayed.

44.en: Nor did we ever feed the needy.

45.en: And we used to delve into falsehood along with those who delved

46.en: and we used to deny the Day of Judgement the Day of Resurrection and Requital

47.en: until finally the inevitable came to us’ — death.

48.en: Thus the intercession of the intercessors from among the angels the prophets and the righteous will not avail them in other words there will be no intercession for them.
48.ar: ﴿فَما تَنْفَعهُمْ شَفاعَة الشّافِعِينَ﴾ مِن المَلائِكَة والأَنْبِياء والصّالِحِينَ والمَعْنى لا شَفاعَة لَهُمْ

49.en: So what fa-mā the subject is wrong with them lahum the predicate thereof semantically connected to an omitted clause the person of which has been transposed onto it that they turn away mu‘ridīna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the suffixed pronoun in lahum ‘them’ from the Reminder — in other words ‘what has happened to them that they have turned away from admonition’ —
49.ar: ﴿فَما﴾ مُبْتَدَأ ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ خَبَره مُتَعَلِّق بِمَحْذُوفٍ انْتَقَلَ ضَمِيره إلَيْهِ ﴿عَنْ التَّذْكِرَة مُعْرِضِينَ﴾ حال مِن الضَّمِير والمَعْنى أيّ شَيْء حَصَلَ لَهُمْ فِي إعْراضهمْ عَنْ الِاتِّعاظ

50.en: as if they were wild asses

51.en: fleeing from a lion? that is to say fleeing from it with absolute fright.
51.ar: ﴿فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَة﴾ أسَد أيْ هَرَبَتْ مِنهُ أشَدّ الهَرَب

52.en: Nay but everyone of them desires to be given unrolled scrolls from God exalted be He enjoining them to follow the Prophet s as they said before ‘And even then we will not believe your ascension until you bring down for us a book that we may read’ Q. 1793.
52.ar: ﴿بَلْ يُرِيد كُلّ امْرِئٍ مِنهُمْ أنْ يُؤْتى صُحُفًا مُنَشَّرَة﴾ أيْ مِن اللَّه تَعالى بِاتِّباعِ النَّبِيّ كَما قالُوا: لَنْ نُؤْمِن لَك حَتّى تُنَزِّل عَلَيْنا كِتابًا نَقْرَؤُهُ

53.en: No indeed! kallā a deterrent of what they desire. Rather they do not fear the Hereafter that is the chastisement thereof.
53.ar: ﴿كَلّا﴾ رَدْع عَمّا أرادُوهُ ﴿بَلْ لا يَخافُونَ الآخِرَة﴾ أيْ عَذابها

54.en: No indeed! kallā a commencement of a new sentence Assuredly it that is the Qur’ān is a Reminder an admonition.

55.en: So whoever wills shall remember it he shall read it and be admonished by it.

56.en: And they will not remember yadhkurūna or read second person plural tadhkurūna unless God wills it. He is the One worthy of your fear and the One worthy to forgive by forgiving those who fear Him.
56.ar: ﴿وما يَذْكُرُونَ﴾ بِالياءِ والتّاء ﴿إلّا أنْ يَشاء اللَّه هُوَ أهْل التَّقْوى﴾ بِأَنْ يُتَّقى ﴿وأَهْل المَغْفِرَة﴾ بِأَنْ يَغْفِر لِمَن اتَّقاهُ
